moveEvidence.speaker: Iain McGilchrist

sourceSpan.excerpt: And so to that extent I agree. But I would say that, significance, the purpose of our life is deeply bound up with value.

quoteEligibleExactSpans: the purpose of our life is deeply bound up with value
moveEvidence.attributionBasis: Immediate McGilchrist response to Kastrup's account of human meaning.

responseComponents.component: Accepts divine self-discovery but argues that humans do more than illuminate perspectives: they participate in creating reality and realizing objective values.

moveEvidence.proposition: McGilchrist partly agrees with the co-discovery account but distinguishes his view by holding that human purpose is deeply bound up with value.
moveEvidence.inventoryRationale: Directly crystallizes the motion's central comparison between perspectival observation and value-directed participation.

option-a.rationale: No distinct debate-wide pro consequence remains uncaptured: the participatory, divine-development, and value claims are already reflected in the ratings of the linked moves.
